items.title: Basin rig count up one as prices drop
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up one this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 273 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 251 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is up one from last week at 604 rigs. A year ago, 548 rigs were active.
